record_key: Repository-relative source path; frontmatter retirementEvidence uses an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into records. Each record shares its family decision and this ledger’s policy, windows, coverage and provenance.

original_audit_source_provenance.purpose: Historical starting source snapshot only; current attention facts and metric contract use the refreshed revisions above.

policy.age_basis: later publication and first followed Git source date; all existing members, including retired translations
policy.family_keep_rule: clicks >= 3 OR distinct family engaged visitor-days >= 2
policy.safeguards: Every existing member must be at least 90 days old. Verified family identity, source coverage and attribution are required; unknown evidence blocks changes. Youth or concrete actual use protects the whole family.

unmapped_zero_click_spellings.disposition: No corresponding source or verified routing alias in corpus or followed/all Git path history; retained as separate diagnostics, with no positive-click ambiguity assigned to an existing family.

engagement_window.limitations: Collection began 2026-09-22 part day; route attribution began 2026-09-23 part day. Only 2026-09-24 through 2026-10-21 supplies reliable negative coverage: 28 complete UTC days. Pre-baseline missing paths remain archived measurement limitations, not reconstructed zeros. The ten-second visible-time plus interaction page-read signal began 2026-10-19 about 21:00 UTC; older single-page reading cannot be reconstructed. Attributable positives throughout the nominal interval, including before the baseline and the current partial day, count. Cohorts remain separate; visitor-days are not unique people.

measurement.search: Page-level WEB Search Console URL exports, including anonymized queries, across verified old/current domains and URL aliases. Sum observations after localized identity mapping; deduplicate overlapping exports of the same property. Export-confirmed empty days are observed coverage. A URL with no rows is zero only after successful complete export and identity coverage.
measurement.engagement: Current app admin buildSiteVisitorDaysCtesSql qualifies across the whole website before article attribution: a page view AND at least two qualifying facts total on the same UTC day, INCLUDING that page view. Preserve origin/trust, bot, admin, test, manual, automation, sandbox, suspicious-burst and materialized scraper-fleet exclusions. Identified days use resolved actor and occurred_at; cookieless days use daily visitor hash and server_received_at. Count distinct (cohort, resolved identity, UTC visit date) across all family URLs/aliases. Never sum per-URL visitor-day counts or combine cohorts. Family engaged views are summed; visitor-days are separately deduplicated.
measurement.attribution: Collector page_path is locale-stripped; ui_locale restores each supported non-English locale once before verified alias matching. Missing or unknown identity/path is unassigned, never English or zero. No unassigned engaged blog views or filtered page views with missing attribution affect the reliable interval/current day. Per-record engagement is the localized canonical URL aggregate over the nominal interval.
measurement.age: Age uses the later publication date and first followed Git source appearance for every existing family member. First appearance is an availability proxy, not proof of deployment. Per-record source hashes/blobs describe the actualized website base before these flags.

provenance.metric_source_parity: Fresh frozen/current app metric files, current/deployed admin metric files and website metric/attribution files compare identically for the refreshed revisions. Current app main supplies the policy builders; deployed admin is recorded separately.
provenance.search_coverage: Latest common complete cutoff 2026-10-20. Old-domain exports cover all 60 dates from 2026-08-22; new-domain exports cover active availability from 2026-09-16, including export-confirmed empty Sep16–17 and partitions on Sep18 onward. Old-domain observations after cutover remain included.
provenance.audience_classification: Expected materialized Android-burst and scraper-fleet classifications were accessible and checked by the fresh audit; the current admin builders retain their exclusions.
provenance.reference_preparation: All 4,129 prospective published blog references resolve to kept sources, including 1,167 effective localization rewrites; zero retired/missing targets, meaningful retired-article referrals or alias-only public links. Reference audit at c4d86144a9dd656d336861a9f332f80ddbdf1a3b; intervening c1474bc4763bae4e91c07a9b5cbb75c78f4d0da7 changes only CSS and preserves content/routing/publication sources.

preservation: Only status: retired and retirementEvidence are added to the 85 live sources. All pre-existing frontmatter and complete bodies remain byte-identical. The 363 already-retired members of these families retain their historical evidence pointers; every prior public ledger remains unchanged.
